newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT- Lehman details US steel stock view.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- Lehman details US steel stock view.

text.p: -- Lehman Bros analyst Richard Aldrich said in a research note he raised his rating on USX-US Steel Group to outperform from neutral and re-emphasized outperform ratings on AK Steel Holding Corp, LTV Corp and Inland Steel Industries Inc.

-- "Booming domestic steel orders, higher domestic scrap prices and rising world steel export prices" are raising the odds of "at least partial success" for a September 29 spot flat-rolled steel price increase, improving prospects for the companies' one-year contract talks, and lowering the near-term downside risk to the stocks "which remain quite depressed."
-- Also, a forthcoming strike at WHX Corp October 1 "looks increasingly likely and could help tighten the near-term steel supply/demand balance further," according to Aldrich.
-- In midsession New York Stock Exchange trade, USX-US Steel added 5/8 to 28-7/8, AK Steel rose 3/8 to 38-5/8, LTV edged up 1/8 to 12-3/4, Inland gained 5/8 to 19 and WHX slipped 1/4 to 10-1/2.
